title: Expose the Schedule API
description:
The Gateway API exposes list, add, show, run, logs, complete, remove, and activate for Schedules under the existing active-peer and Node-access boundary. The operations are in [ADR 0013](<https://github.com/nckrtl/orbit/blob/main/docs/decisions/0013-native-systemd-schedule-management.md>).

## Scope

* In: Schedule requests, data objects, controllers, routes, and bounded response envelopes for the eight operations
* In: active-peer middleware, Node-access policy, collection filtering, installed-Node completion authorization, and sanitized activity records
* Out: Schedule editing, numeric lookup, and command text or completion in any activity
* Out: Doctor repair, mutation, adoption, or persisted reports
* Out: the PHP SDK and CLI ([ORB-3](https://linear.app/nckrtl/issue/ORB-3/add-schedule-and-doctor-transport-to-the-php-sdk), [ORB-71](https://linear.app/nckrtl/issue/ORB-71/add-schedule-and-doctor-commands-to-the-cli)), production deployment, and harness changes

## Acceptance

- [ ] Exactly eight Schedule routes exist and are keyed by UUID; a well-formed unknown UUID returns `404`, and malformed, duplicate, escaped-duplicate, unknown, or wrongly typed members return `422` before mutation. Proof: `apps/gateway/tests/Feature/Api/SchedulesTest.php`.
- [ ] Every operation enforces active-peer and Node access, a collection returns only Schedules whose target Node the caller may address, and completion is accepted only from the installed Node. Proof: `apps/gateway/tests/Feature/Api/SchedulesTest.php`.
- [ ] Completion creates no Activity, and each of the other seven operations creates one sanitized Activity that contains no command, calendar, log, output, path, user, or unit text. Proof: `apps/gateway/tests/Feature/Api/SchedulesTest.php`.
- [ ] List omits command text, show and logs return bounded values only to an authorized caller, and command and log text never appear in validation errors or exception text. Proof: `apps/gateway/tests/Feature/Api/SchedulesTest.php`.
- [ ] Maintained documentation states the public Schedule API, authorization, activity, and completion contract, and generated context is current. Proof: `composer docs-lint`.
- [ ] Gateway checks pass. Proof: `cd apps/gateway && composer check`.
- [ ] All repository test suites pass. Proof: all five full no-TIA CI suites on the submitted candidate, plus focused affected Pest tests locally.
- [ ] `POST /schedules/{uuid}/activate` accepts an empty body, authorizes the owning AppInstance Node, and returns the bounded Schedule response; a Node-owned target returns `schedule.target_invalid`, and repeated activation is idempotent. Proof: `apps/gateway/tests/Feature/Api/SchedulesTest.php`.
- [ ] Add accepts optional boolean `start` for AppInstance targets, defaulting to true; false is rejected for Node targets. List and show expose `desired_timer_state` as `enabled` or `disabled`, independently of installation lifecycle state; run does not change it. Proof: `apps/gateway/tests/Feature/Api/SchedulesTest.php`.
